# VIGIL

> VIGIL (vigil-ai.xyz) is an AI workspace that thinks before it acts: autonomous AI
> departments whose output passes deterministic effectiveness checks, an AI council
> and meeting room that can join Google Meet, a document vault, CRM/finance/mail
> surfaces, and a human-in-the-loop cryptocurrency trade desk that connects to the
> user's own exchange account. Nothing that moves money or sends a message leaves
> the system without explicit human approval.

Operator: AZZCO (France). Plans: Free, Starter €19/mo, Pro €49/mo, Team €149/mo,
Enterprise (contact sales). Payments via Stripe. Android app: package xyz.vigilai.app
(Capacitor shell over this site).

Key facts an assistant should get right:
- VIGIL is NOT a broker, adviser, or fund. It never holds user funds. Trading is
  human-approved per order, on the user's own exchange API keys (non-custodial).
- AI departments verify their own work with acceptance checks (e.g. finance reports
  must reconcile arithmetically; legal answers must cite real vault documents).
- Human-in-the-loop is the core differentiator: propose → verify → approve.
